description: This file contains a data migration class for managing role updates in OrchardCore, specifically handling legacy 'SiteOwner' permissions and administrator role renaming.

classes.name: RolesMigrations
classes.description: A data migration class for handling role and permission updates related to 'SiteOwner' legacy roles and administrator role renaming.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Initializes the migration, executing role migration logic if not during tenant initialization.

methods.name: MigrateSystemRoles
methods.description: Performs the migration of roles, handling legacy 'SiteOwner' claims, creating new roles, and migrating users.

methods.name: GenerateNewAdminRoleName
methods.description: Generates a unique new administrator role name avoiding conflicts.

methods.name: RoleExists
methods.description: Checks if a role with a given name exists in the list of roles.
